title: Mid-Training Language Models on Raw Video
title_zh: 在原始视频上进行中期训练的语言模型

paragraphs.en: Multimodal large language models learn mostly from paired image-text data or annotated video, and raw web video is rarely used to further train an existing language model. We study whether raw video, with no captions and no text loss, can serve as mid-training data for a pretrained language model. Frames are encoded into continuous visual tokens, and the language model learns to predict the next visual token. We mid-train Qwen3-1.7B on raw clips from YT-Temporal-1B and then apply the same image-text instruction tuning to it and to the model without mid-training, so that the two differ only in mid-training. The mid-trained model scores 2.9 points higher on average across four video benchmarks and 5.1 points higher across ten image benchmarks, spanning perception, document, and chart tasks. Text performance is preserved even though mid-training includes no text, with an average of 48.9 across 14 text benchmarks compared with 48.0 for the model without mid-training. Analyses across training show that the image and video gains emerge within 30% of training and plateau thereafter, varying by less than 0.5 points. Predicting captions fails to outperform next-visual-token prediction, demonstrating that video mid-training can remain purely self-supervised without the computational overhead or labeling noise of automated captioning.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态大语言模型主要通过学习成对出现的图像-文本数据或带标注的视频来训练，而原始网络视频很少被用于进一步训练现有的语言模型。 我们研究了在没有字幕和文本损失的情况下，原始视频是否可以作为预训练语言模型的中途训练数据。 视频帧被编码为连续的视觉标记，而语言模型则学习预测下一个视觉标记。 我们在 YT-Temporal-1B 的原始片段上对 Qwen3-1.7B 进行了中途训练，然后对其以及未进行中途训练的模型应用相同的图像-文本指令微调，使得两者仅在中途训练环节存在差异。 经过中途训练的模型在四个视频基准测试中的平均得分高出 2.9 分，在十个涵盖感知、文档和图表任务的图像基准测试中平均高出 5.1 分。 尽管中途训练完全不包含文本，但模型的文本性能依然得以保留：在 14 项文本基准测试中的平均得分为 48.9 分，而未进行中途训练的模型平均得分为 48.0 分。 跨不同训练阶段的分析表明，图像和视频相关的性能提升在训练进度达到 30% 时即已显现，此后趋于稳定，差异小于 0.5 分。 预测字幕并未超越预测下一个视觉标记的表现，这表明视频中途训练可以完全采用自监督方式，无需承担自动生成字幕所带来的计算负担或标注噪声。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced rapidly across reasoning, coding, and knowledge-intensive tasks ( Achiam et al., 2023 ; Brown et al., 2020 ; Gemma Team et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . These capabilities have been driven in large part by data scaling, with recent models trained on tens of trillions of tokens, well beyond compute-optimal allocations ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . However, training set growth already outpaces human text generation, and the stock of public human text is projected to be fully used in a decade ( Villalobos et al., 2024 ) . Scaling the text pretraining corpus, a central driver of progress under neural scaling laws ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) , is therefore approaching fundamental limits. Repeated text yields diminishing returns beyond a few epochs ( Muennighoff et al., 2023 ) , and recursive training on synthetic text degrades model quality ( Shumailov et al., 2024 ) . Sustaining scaling trends necessitates drawing upon non-text modalities.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在推理、编码和知识密集型任务方面取得了快速进展（Achiam 等人，2023；Brown 等人，2020；Gemma Team 等人，2025；Yang 等人，2025）。 这些能力的提升在很大程度上得益于数据规模的扩大，近期模型的训练数据规模已达数万亿个词元，远超计算资源的最优分配水平（Hoffmann 等人，2022；Yang 等人，2025）。 然而，训练数据集的增长速度已经超过了人类文本的生成速度，预计公共人类文本库将在十年内被完全使用（Villalobos 等人，2024）。 因此，扩大文本预训练语料库——在神经缩放定律下推动进步的核心因素（Kaplan 等人，2020；Hoffmann 等人，2022）——正逐渐接近其根本极限。 重复使用文本在超过几个训练周期后收益会递减（Muennighoff 等人，2023），而对合成文本进行递归训练则会降低模型质量（Shumailov 等人，2024）。 要维持当前的扩展趋势，必须利用非文本模态的数据。

paragraphs.en: Among non-text modalities, video is the largest source of data. Its stock is estimated at roughly 1350 trillion text-token equivalents, about 2.6 times the indexed web ( Villalobos et al., 2024 ) . Video also suits language model training, since its frames arrive in temporal order like tokens in text and show objects, actions, and scenes that text describes only indirectly. Yet current multimodal models use video mainly through text, pairing sampled frames with captions or question-answer annotations ( An et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) . Captioning web-scale video frame by frame is expensive, and the captions inherit the errors and omissions of the captioning model. This raises the question of whether a pretrained language model can learn from raw video directly, with no captions, by predicting the next visual token.
paragraphs.zh: 在非文本模态中，视频是最大的数据源。 其数据量估计约为 1350 万亿个文本词元当量，大约是已索引网页数据的 2.6 倍（Villalobos 等人，2024）。 视频也适合语言模型训练，因为它的帧以时间顺序呈现，就像文本中的词元一样，并且展示了文本只能间接描述的对象、动作和场景。 然而，当前的多模态模型主要通过文本使用视频，即将采样后的帧与字幕或问答标注配对（An 等人，2026；Bai 等人，2025）。 对网络规模的视频逐帧添加字幕成本高昂，而且这些字幕会继承字幕生成模型本身的错误和遗漏。 这引发了一个问题：一个预训练的语言模型是否可以直接从原始视频中学习，无需任何字幕，仅通过预测下一个视觉词元来实现。

paragraphs.en: While world models trained on large-scale video show that predicting future observations, in pixel space or in a learned representation space, supports simulation, planning, and control ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA, 2026 ) , integrating raw video into language model pretraining remains challenging. Prior multimodal efforts either train unified transformers from scratch on text, image, and video tokens ( Wang et al., 2026 ) or add latent future-frame prediction heads over curated video clips ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Neither directly addresses the most practical regime for scaling, namely continued pretraining of an existing, pretrained LLM on raw web video.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管基于大规模视频训练的世界模型表明，在像素空间或学习到的表示空间中预测未来观测结果有助于模拟、规划和控制（Assran 等人，2025；Bruce 等人，2024；NVIDIA，2026），但将原始视频整合到语言模型的预训练中仍然充满挑战。 早期的多模态研究要么从头开始使用文本、图像和视频标记训练统一的 Transformer（Wang 等人，2026），要么在精心挑选的视频片段上添加潜在的未来帧预测头（Yang 等人，2026）。 这两种方法都没有直接解决扩展性方面最实用的方案，即对现有的预训练大型语言模型继续用原始网络视频进行预训练。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we mid-train a pretrained language model on raw video with next-token prediction over visual tokens. Each frame is encoded by a pretrained vision encoder and projected into the language model’s embedding space, turning a clip into a continuous sequence of visual tokens. The language model learns to predict each next visual token from its hidden state, with no captions or discrete visual tokenizer.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们对预训练语言模型进行中期训练，使用原始视频数据，并通过视觉标记的下一个标记预测任务进行训练。 每一帧都由一个预训练的视觉编码器进行编码，并投影到语言模型的嵌入空间中，从而将一段视频片段转化为连续的视觉标记序列。 该语言模型能够根据自身的隐藏状态预测下一个视觉标记，整个过程无需任何字幕或离散的视觉标记化器。

Video mid-training raises the average over four video benchmarks by 2.9 points, with a 4.8-point gain on EgoSchema, and the average over ten image benchmarks by 5.1 points. Although mid-training includes no text, the mid-trained model preserves text performance, raising the average text score from 48.0 to 48.9 and keeping every knowledge and commonsense score within 1.4 points of the model without mid-training. Replacing the visual target with a caption of the next frame gives similar video and image scores but lowers the average text score by 1.5 points, and a caption of the current frame leaves the image average at 48.8, within 0.1 points of the baseline. Video mid-training therefore needs no frame-level captions.

paragraphs.en: Our primary contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose mid-training a pretrained language model on raw video by predicting the next visual token, which requires no captions or annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出在预训练语言模型的中期训练阶段，通过预测下一个视觉标记来使用原始视频进行训练，这一过程无需任何字幕或标注。

paragraphs.en: We show that video mid-training improves video understanding by 2.9 points on average (4.8 points on EgoSchema) and image understanding by 5.1 points, while maintaining baseline text performance despite using no text supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，在训练中期引入视频数据可将视频理解能力平均提升 2.9 分（EgoSchema 上为 4.8 分），图像理解能力提升 5.1 分，同时在未使用任何文本监督的情况下，仍保持了基线文本模型的性能。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that video mid-training eliminates the need for expensive captioning pipelines, as predicting current- or next-frame captions provides no advantage over purely self-supervised next-visual-token prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，在训练中期引入视频数据可以消除对昂贵字幕生成流程的需求，因为预测当前或下一帧的字幕并不会比纯粹的自监督下一视觉词元预测带来任何优势。

paragraphs.en: Self-supervised video models are trained by reconstructing masked spatiotemporal patches ( Tong et al., 2022 ) , autoregressively generating discrete visual tokens ( Yan et al., 2021 ) , or predicting representations in a latent feature space ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) . When scaled to internet video, predictive objectives yield rich representations that support physical planning ( Assran et al., 2025 ) as well as generative world models that simulate interactive environments ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA, 2026 ) . However, these models are trained strictly from scratch in the visual domain and typically incorporate language only post hoc through downstream probing or fine-tuning. In contrast, rather than training a standalone video backbone, our objective is to investigate what an already-competent language model acquires when trained directly on continuous visual streams.
paragraphs.zh: 自监督视频模型通过重建被遮蔽的时空局部区域（Tong 等人，2022）、自回归地生成离散的视觉标记（Yan 等人，2021），或预测潜在特征空间中的表示（Assran 等人，2023；Assran 等人，2025）进行训练。 当模型规模扩展至互联网视频时，预测目标能够产生丰富的表示，既支持物理规划（Assran 等人，2025），也能构建生成式世界模型以模拟交互式环境（Bruce 等人，2024；NVIDIA，2026）。 然而，这些模型完全从头开始在视觉领域进行训练，并且通常仅在事后通过下游探测或微调的方式引入语言信息。 相比之下，我们的目标并非训练一个独立的视频主干网络，而是研究一个已经具备能力的语言模型在直接训练于连续视觉流时能够获得哪些知识。

paragraphs.en: An emerging line of research explores video as pretraining data for language architectures. Tong et al. (2026) pretrain a transformer from scratch on a joint mixture of text and raw video, finding that adding video keeps text perplexity close to text-only pretraining, lower on in-distribution web text but higher on an out-of-distribution corpus. However, their setup trains jointly from scratch with an explicit text language modeling loss. Similarly, Emu3 ( Wang et al., 2026 ) pretrains a single transformer from scratch across interleaved discrete image, video, and text tokens. Cambrian-S ( Yang et al., 2026 ) adds a latent frame prediction head to a vision-language model and trains it jointly with spatial instruction tuning on a curated video corpus. Other recent efforts cast diverse multimodal tasks as video frame prediction ( Hudson et al., 2025 ) or train vision-language models to anticipate and describe future environmental states ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Unlike these methods, we continue training an existing pretrained language model instead of training from scratch, and we use raw web video with no captions and no text loss. The model learns only to predict the next continuous visual token, so video extends its autoregressive pretraining rather than serving as a task format or an instruction-tuning signal.

paragraphs.en: Standard vision-language models connect a pretrained vision encoder ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) to a causal language model ( Yang et al., 2025 ) via a learned projection layer, followed by supervised instruction tuning on multimodal data ( Tong et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Under this conventional recipe, the language model encounters visual tokens primarily during instruction tuning, and video is reduced to a sparse subset of sampled frames. To bridge the gap between static image pretraining and downstream tasks, recent open models add a large-scale multimodal mid-training stage in which video is supervised mainly through synthesized clip captions ( An et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) . Our ablations show that next-frame captions give no gain over predicting continuous visual features directly (see Section 4.4 ). Bypassing caption generation lets video mid-training use large web collections such as YT-Temporal-1B ( Zellers et al., 2022 ) without any annotation.
paragraphs.zh: 标准的视觉语言模型通过一个可学习的投影层，将预训练的视觉编码器（Zhai 等人，2023）与因果语言模型（Yang 等人，2025）连接起来，随后在多模态数据上进行有监督的指令微调（Tong 等人，2024；Li 等人，2025）。 在这种传统方法中，语言模型主要在指令微调阶段接触视觉标记，而视频则被简化为采样帧的一个稀疏子集。 为了弥合静态图像预训练与下游任务之间的差距，近期的开放模型在中期训练阶段加入了大规模多模态内容，其中视频主要通过合成的片段标题进行监督（An 等人，2026；Bai 等人，2025）。 我们的消融研究表明，预测下一帧的标题并未比直接预测连续的视觉特征带来任何提升（参见第 4.4 节）。 跳过标题生成步骤后，视频的中期训练可以直接利用 YT-Temporal-1B（Zellers 等人，2022）等大型网络数据集，而无需任何标注。

paragraphs.en: We formulate video mid-training as autoregressive next-token prediction over continuous visual representations, keeping the causal decoder-only architecture of the language model. Rather than quantizing video into discrete codebooks ( Yan et al., 2021 ) or relying on generated text captions ( An et al., 2026 ) , our approach encodes raw video frames into continuous feature vectors that directly populate the input space of the language model backbone. The model is trained on this serialized visual stream via self-supervised feature regression, without paired captions or any language loss (see Figure 1 ). This enables seamless data scaling by bypassing the cost and complexity of manual annotation or synthetic pseudo-captioning pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将视频中间训练建模为对连续视觉表示的自回归下一词预测，同时保留语言模型中仅含因果解码器的架构。 与将视频量化为离散码本（Yan et al., 2021）或依赖生成的文本描述（An et al., 2026）不同，我们的方法将原始视频帧编码为连续特征向量，直接填充语言模型主干的输入空间。 该模型通过自监督特征回归在这一序列化的视觉流上进行训练，无需配对描述或任何语言损失（见图1）。 这使得数据扩展能够无缝进行，因为它绕过了手动标注或合成伪描述流程所带来的成本与复杂性。

paragraphs.en: We draw mid-training video from YT-Temporal-1B (YT-1B) ( Zellers et al., 2022 ) , a collection of approximately 20 million public YouTube videos. After excluding videos that are no longer accessible online, our source pool comprises 17 million videos. Frames are sampled at 0.2 fps (one frame every five seconds). From videos containing between 16 and 63 sampled frames, we extract contiguous 16-frame clips starting at random temporal offsets. The composed dataset contains 6.99M clips with 64.4B visual tokens in our implementation. For subsequent supervised fine-tuning, we incorporate LLaVA-OneVision-Data ( Li et al., 2025 ) (3.9M images, 3.2B tokens).
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 YT-Temporal-1B（YT-1B）（Zellers 等人，2022）中获取训练中期视频，该数据集包含约 2000 万条公开的 YouTube 视频。 在排除已无法在线访问的视频后，我们的源视频库包含 1700 万条视频。 我们以 0.2 fps（每五秒抽取一帧）的速率对视频帧进行采样。 对于包含 16 至 63 个采样帧的视频，我们从随机的时间偏移处提取连续的 16 帧片段。 在我们实现的版本中，最终构建的数据集包含 699 万个片段和 644 亿个视觉标记。 在后续的监督微调阶段，我们引入了 LLaVA-OneVision-Data（Li 等人，2025）（390 万张图片，32 亿个标记）。

paragraphs.en: All model parameters ( ϕ , ψ , θ , ω \phi,\psi,\theta,\omega ) are trained end-to-end for one epoch (27,300 steps) across 128 NVIDIA H100 GPUs. We train with an effective batch size of 256 clips and a context window of 16k tokens. We use AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with a learning rate of 0.00001 for the language model and projector and 0.000002 for the vision encoder, with cosine decay and a 3% linear warmup. Following mid-training, we instruction-tune mid-trained models for one epoch on LLaVA-OneVision data ( Li et al., 2025 ) using the same training parameters used in mid-training.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate instruction-tuned models across video, static image, and text suites. Video understanding. We group the video benchmarks by the ability they test, namely long-form egocentric understanding with EgoSchema ( Mangalam et al., 2023 ) , general video question answering with NExT-QA ( Xiao et al., 2021 ) and Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , and fine-grained temporal reasoning with TempCompass ( Liu et al., 2024b ) . Image understanding. We group the image benchmarks by task type, namely text-rich image understanding ( Masry et al., 2022 ; Mathew et al., 2021 ; Mathew et al., 2022 ; Singh et al., 2019 ) , general perception and diagram understanding ( Kembhavi et al., 2016 ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2024 ) , text recognition ( Liu et al., 2024c ) , and visual reasoning ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024b ) . Text understanding and reasoning. To measure how well the model retains its language ability, we evaluate commonsense reasoning and world knowledge ( Bisk et al., 2020 ; Clark et al., 2018 ; Clark et al., 2019 ; Hendrycks et al., 2021a ; Mihaylov et al., 2018 ; Sakaguchi et al., 2021 ; Sap et al., 2019 ; Zellers et al., 2019 ) , mathematical, scientific, and multi-step reasoning ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Hendrycks et al., 2021b ; Lightman et al., 2024 ; Rein et al., 2024 ; Suzgun et al., 2023 ) , and code generation ( Austin et al., 2021 ) .

paragraphs.en: Image and video benchmarks are evaluated via lmms-eval ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , where multiple-choice questions are scored by option-letter log-likelihood and open-ended queries are decoded greedily. Multiple-choice and short-answer text benchmarks are evaluated zero-shot by ranking candidate-answer log-likelihoods. Free-form text benchmarks use greedy decoding with standard few-shot exemplars: eight for GSM8K, and three for MBPP and BBH. Finally, GPQA is evaluated via lighteval ( Habib et al., 2023 ) in non-reasoning mode with an 8,192-token generation budget, a presence penalty of 1.5, and top- k = 20 k=20 .

paragraphs.en: Tables 1 , 2 , and 3 report downstream evaluation results across video, image, and text benchmarks, respectively. paragraphs.en: On text benchmarks, multimodal instruction tuning lowers performance on mathematical and multi-step reasoning, dropping 23.5 points on GSM8K, 17.7 points on MATH500, and 15.0 points on BBH relative to the original Qwen3-1.7B, while leaving knowledge and commonsense benchmarks largely unaffected. Prior vision-language models report the same loss and reduce it by mixing text-only data into training ( Lu et al., 2024a ) , whereas our instruction-tuning set contains only image-text examples. The mid-trained model shows the same pattern with a smaller drop, 18.6 points on GSM8K, 16.5 points on MATH500, and 9.5 points on BBH. One possible reason is that mid-training has already adapted the language model to visual tokens, so instruction tuning needs to change it less.
paragraphs.zh: 在文本基准测试中，多模态指令微调会降低数学和多步推理任务的性能：与原始 Qwen3-1.7B 相比，GSM8K 得分下降 23.5 分，MATH500 下降 17.7 分，BBH 下降 15.0 分，而知识和本体常识基准测试基本未受影响。 早期的视觉语言模型也报告了同样的性能损失，并通过将纯文本数据混合到训练中来减少这种损失（Lu et al., 2024a），而我们的指令微调数据集仅包含图像-文本示例。 中期训练模型表现出相同的趋势，但下降幅度较小：GSM8K 下降 18.6 分，MATH500 下降 16.5 分，BBH 下降 9.5 分。 一个可能的原因是，在中期训练阶段，语言模型已经适应了视觉标记，因此指令微调需要对其进行的调整更少。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 breaks down individual benchmark trajectories. After full mid-training, the largest video gains are on long-form egocentric understanding (EgoSchema) and general video question answering (NExT-QA, VideoMME), while fine-grained temporal reasoning (TempCompass) improves by 1.5 points. Averaged by task type, the largest image gains at the end of mid-training are on text-rich image understanding (+5.8 points) and general perception and diagram understanding (+5.2 points), followed by visual reasoning (+4.4 points) and text recognition (+3.2 points). Across all evaluation intervals, scores on commonsense, knowledge, coding, and GPQA remain within 3 points of the baseline. In contrast, reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH500, BBH) fluctuate by up to 9 points.
paragraphs.zh: 图4详细展示了各项基准测试的轨迹。 中期训练结束后，视频任务中提升最大的是长形式第一人称视角理解（EgoSchema）和通用视频问答（NExT-QA、VideoMME），而精细时间推理（TempCompass）则提升了1.5分。 按任务类型平均计算，中期训练结束时图像任务中提升最大的是文本密集型图像理解（+5.8分）和通用感知与图表理解（+5.2分），其次是视觉推理（+4.4分）和文本识别（+3.2分）。 在所有评估阶段，常识、知识、编码和GPQA的得分始终与基线模型相差在3分以内。 相比之下，推理基准测试（GSM8K、MATH500、BBH）的波动幅度最高可达9分。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 demonstrates that purely self-supervised visual next-token prediction is sufficient for effective mid-training, matching or outperforming objectives that supervise with frame-level dense captions. We compare our approach against two caption-based targets, namely current-caption and next-caption prediction, where the continuous visual target is replaced by a text caption of the current or next frame (see Section 4.1.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表 4 表明，纯自监督的视觉下一词预测足以实现有效的中期训练，其效果与使用帧级密集字幕进行监督的目标相当，甚至更优。 我们将我们的方法与两种基于字幕的目标进行了比较，即当前字幕预测和下一字幕预测，其中连续的视觉目标被替换为当前或下一帧的文本字幕（参见第 4.1.3 节）。

sents.en: We compare our approach against two caption-based targets, namely current-caption and next-caption prediction, where the continuous visual target is replaced by a text caption of the current or next frame (see Section 4.1.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Predicting next-frame captions yields no empirical advantage over predicting visual tokens directly. It yields similar video and image scores, but degrades language performance by 1.5 points. Even when controlling for training budget by comparing against our 0.5-epoch visual model (52.37 video, 53.76 image, 48.32 text), visual next-token prediction matches vision gains within 0.3 points while better preserving text capability. Current-caption prediction likewise fails to offer a compelling alternative, falling 5.0 points behind visual tokens on image understanding and showing inconsistent transfer across tasks. These comparisons establish that raw visual token prediction is sufficient on its own, allowing video mid-training to remain fully self-supervised while avoiding the computational overhead and label noise of caption generation.
paragraphs.zh: 预测下一帧的标题并未在实证上优于直接预测视觉词元。 这种方法在视频和图像任务上的得分相近，但语言性能下降了 1.5 分。 即使通过与我们训练了 0.5 个周期的视觉模型（视频 52.37、图像 53.76、文本 48.32）进行比较来控制训练预算，视觉下一词元预测在视觉任务上的增益差异不超过 0.3 分，同时能更好地保留文本能力。 当前标题的预测同样未能提供有说服力的替代方案：在图像理解任务上比视觉词元低 5.0 分，且跨任务的迁移表现不一致。 这些比较表明，仅靠原始视觉词元预测就足以完成任务，这使得视频训练中期仍能保持完全自监督，同时避免了标题生成所带来的计算开销和标签噪声。

paragraphs.en: We propose autoregressive next-token prediction on raw web video as a mid-training objective without text supervision that bridges language pretraining and multimodal instruction tuning. Despite seeing only continuous video frames, the model gains 2.9 points on video-language and 5.1 points on image-language benchmarks, with the greatest improvements in text-rich image understanding and general perception. Predicting next-frame captions offers no advantage over predicting raw visual tokens, demonstrating that video mid-training can remain entirely self-supervised without the expense or label noise of captioning pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出在原始网络视频上进行自回归的下一个词元预测，作为无需文本监督的训练中期目标，以衔接语言预训练和多模态指令调优。 尽管模型仅看到连续的视频帧，但在视频-语言基准测试上获得了 2.9 分的提升，在图像-语言基准测试上获得了 5.1 分的提升，其中文本丰富的图像理解和通用感知方面的改进最为显著。 预测下一帧的标题并未比预测原始视觉词元带来任何优势，这表明视频中期训练可以完全保持自监督，而无需承担标题生成流程所带来的成本或标签噪声。

Both models score below the original language model on GSM8K, MATH500, and BBH, and for the model without mid-training this drop comes from instruction tuning alone. While the mid-trained model degrades less, its 5.5-point margin on BBH is smaller than the 11.7-point discrepancy between instruction-tuning runs from the same initial state.

paragraphs.en: Downstream multimodal gains appear within the first 0.3 epochs, after which scores change by less than 0.5 points across the remainder of training. Whether denser temporal sampling or longer sequence horizons can yield further improvements remains an open question. In addition, determining whether these gains stem from temporal structure or simply from additional exposure to visual tokens requires future frame-shuffling experiments.
